2067: /// Only a same-origin relative path is accepted: it must start with a single
2068: /// `/` (not `//`, which would be protocol-relative), must not contain a scheme

2070: /// caller falls back to a safe default. This is the lab's open-redirect guard
2071: /// for both password and magic-link continuation.
2072: fn validate_continuation(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
2073:     let v = value.trim();
2074:     if v.is_empty() {
2075:         return None;
2076:     }
2077:     // Must be a relative path.
2078:     if !v.starts_with('/') {
2079:         return None;
2080:     }
2081:     // Reject protocol-relative (`//host/...`) and any scheme (`://`).

2084:     }

2087:         return None;
2088:     }
